pr_body:
Signed-off-by: xhe <xw897002528@gmail.com>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #30960 

Problem Summary: Depends on tikv/pd#4508. Now we have "PENDING" to indicate PD did not start the schedule at all. It is possibly caused by busy looping or unmet condition, whatever, it is not scheduling.

I'll complete the document in another PR, since there are other document changes.

### What is changed and how it works?

issue_context.title: placement: show a better hint message for schduleing state
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

> The replication API should report "UNABLE TO SCHEDULE" instead of "INPROGRESS" if the rule can not be applied immediately. There are many such scenarios where this could happen (followers=N and stores is < N).

Refer tikv/pd#4467.

review_comments: The maximum length of JSON strings will be checked here.

The result from PD just can not be too long. It really should not give error.

And assuming that `unmarshal` fails, we would just return `PENDING` as the default fallback, which totally makes sense for me. If you check it, you could return a different word like `ERROR` though.
